title: Riceball Couple 1
summary: A short story about a riceball couple to practice the use of frequency words
content:
My boyfriend and I sometimes watch movies.
We often cuddle.
He usually sleeps late.
I rarely snore.
My boyfriend never yells.
I am almost always quiet
He frequently supports women’s rights.
I occasionally dismantle the patriarchy
We often make out
We always communicate.
We generally have fun.
We always love each other.

title: Riceball Lady 2
summary: A short story about a riceball lady to practice the use of “because”
content:
This is some text I killed a stranger.
Because he asked me to smile.
I killed a fashion designer.
Because he made pants without pockets.
I killed my brother.
Because he left the toilet seat up.
I killed my phone.
Because it only understands a man’s voice.
I killed a woman in the bathroom.
Because she wouldn’t lend me a pad.
I killed the supreme court.
Because they took my rights.

title: Riceball Lady 1
summary: A short story about a riceball lady to practice the use of “so”
content:
This is some text I went to work but I don’t have a car
So I took the train
A pervert touched me
so I killed him.
I worked late but my boss doesn’t pay overtime
So I killed him
I went home to my apartment
I love my boyfriend
But he was cheating on me
So I killed him
I went to sleep. It was a long day.
